svg.aria-label: Audit-first: Each skill reads what is already there and applies only the missing move. Run it twice: the second run is a no-op. Seams, not vendor calls: fetcher, captureError, env and queryKeys sit behind one point each. A vendor swap is a one-file change. Profile, not assumptions: The wizard writes .claude/stack-profile.md. Every skill reads it first, so defaults stay defaults
